headline:
Good bread.
Great company.
intro: Handcrafted sourdough, sweet loaves, and little reasons to slow down. From our home bakery in Florence, Arizona, to your table.
announcement: Made with care. Shared with love. • Florence, Arizona

products.name: Classic Sourdough
products.description: A beautifully simple loaf. Bring the butter, gather around, and make a moment of it.

products.name: Cinnamon Rolls
products.description: Soft swirls of cinnamon goodness. A sweet little reason to linger over breakfast.

products.name: Cookies by the Dozen
products.description: Chocolate chip, sugar, or the bakery’s popular Cowboy cookies. Good things come by the dozen.

products.name: Flavored Sourdough
products.description: Your favorite loaf with a little something extra. Choose a savory or sweet combination.

products.name: Banana Nut Loaf
products.description: A familiar favorite for coffee breaks, breakfast tables, and just-one-more-slice afternoons.

products.name: Blueberry Lemon Loaf
products.description: A bright blueberry-and-lemon pairing to bring a little sunshine to the table.

products.name: Carrot Loaf
products.description: A cozy sweet loaf for a quiet morning or an afternoon catch-up.

products.name: Zucchini Loaf
products.description: A homestyle favorite, ready to slice and share.

products.name: English Muffins
products.description: A breakfast favorite. Toast, top, and make them your own.
